headline: Chinese humanoid maker Astribot has raised about 1 billion yuan in its fourth funding round in six months, lifting its value to 15 billion yuan.
score_reason: Pool score 6 kept: a large, fast-repeating funding round for a humanoid maker, but the figures are the company's own relayed by one site.
importance_line: Shoppers and workers in China could meet these robots sooner as money pours into Chinese humanoid makers, but the valuation, shipping and capacity figures come from the company and one finance site.
summary: BigGo Finance reports, citing Astribot's announcement of 13 Oct 2026, that the Chinese humanoid robot maker closed a round of about 1 billion yuan ($149.4 million) led by Toukong Donghai (Shenzhen Investment Holdings), valuing it at 15 billion yuan ($2.2 billion), only about three months after a June Series B that first took it past 10 billion yuan. Astribot says the money will go to model development, hiring, commercial rollout and production capacity, that its S and T series now have combined capacity of 10,000 units, and that its T1 humanoid, priced at around 90,000 yuan, has shipped since June 2026.
notes: Read in full from the pool fulltext. Figures follow BigGo Finance (1 billion yuan at a 15 billion yuan valuation) as instructed, not the 36Kr English version (10 billion and 150 billion). Company figures relayed by one finance site.
